name: Nest Treasury Vault
oneLiner: nTBILL is Nest's NAV-accreting Treasury vault token, routing into Janus Henderson JTRSY and Superstate USTB short-duration T-bill exposure.
collateral: Tokenised short-duration U.S. Treasury exposure routed by Nest into Janus Henderson JTRSY and Superstate USTB positions, plus a small stablecoin liquidity buffer
pegMechanism: Vault LP token whose value targets a dollar base and accretes through underlying Treasury fund NAV; primary mint and redemption occur through Nest at vault NAV against USDC and pUSD

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Nest retains issuer / admin authority over vault shares with permissioned issuance and freeze surfaces beyond reserve-only exposure.

notices.title: NAV-style dollar asset
notices.message: nTBILL is a Nest vault share whose value tracks the underlying Treasury fund book. It behaves like a vault share rather than a hard 1:1 par stablecoin.

mintAuthority.summary: nTBILL is a Nest vault share on the Nucleus/BoringVault architecture; the permissioned Teller mints/burns shares when users deposit pUSD at vault NAV, while the Nest-controlled Manager directs Treasury-fund allocation. There is no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route.

controls.label: Nest Treasury Vault Teller (issuance/redemption)
controls.evidence: In the Nest/Nucleus BoringVault model the Teller is the only contract that mints and burns vault receipt tokens against pUSD deposits at the Accountant-computed NAV; minting is permissioned through the vault rather than open.

controls.label: Nest Treasury Vault Manager (strategy/admin)
controls.evidence: The Manager contract is Nest-controlled and oversees vault strategy, allocation, and configuration; it sits in the admin path over the BoringVault/Teller issuance.

review.evidence: Nest vaults run the Nucleus BoringVault stack (BoringVault token + Teller minter + Accountant pricing + Nest-controlled Manager); shares are minted only by the Teller on deposit and the Manager governs strategy, so supply creation is fully permissioned by Nest. Teller/Manager addresses taken from Nest's published contract list; on-chain role/owner not independently read.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain owner/authority of the Teller and Manager (Safe vs EOA) before raising confidence.
